summary: Multi-Instructor Pick (v2.6) validation. Backend: 14/16 pytest tests PASS (87.5%). Two CRITICAL failures on PUT /api/auth/me/instructors with follow=true because /app/backend/routes/instructors.py:_upsert_follows() writes documents with field name 'following_id' while the rest of the codebase (services/social.py, services/startup.py) uses 'followee_id' as the second element of the (follower_id, followee_id) unique index. Result: the first upsert inserts {followee_id: null}, the second (or any later) upsert for the same caller hits E11000 duplicate key and returns 500. This blocks the flagship v2.6 use case (dancer picks Erin + Jamin with follow toggle ON — server returns 500 the moment the loop tries to insert the second follow row). Even in the single-target case where the insert succeeds, the row is invisible to the follow-graph code because following_ids()/follower_ids() query on 'followee_id', so auto-follow is effectively a no-op for the rest of the app. All other backend rules validated green: main_instructor_id resolution precedence (explicit → existing-if-still-selected → first-in-list → cleared), invalid instructor_ids silently dropped, empty list clears main, PATCH /main-instructor $addToSet's into instructor_ids (idempotent — no dupes), /auth/me now includes instructor_ids array, regression endpoints (/instructors, /suggestions fallback, /suggestions/for-instructor, /weekly-recap) all still 200. Frontend smoke on 390x844: PickInstructorSheet opens from Profile → 'My instructors' row, all required testIDs render (pick-instructor-sheet, -search, -clear, -follow-toggle, -save, -cancel, -close, -{userId}, -star-{userId}), multi-select checkboxes work, star icon marks 'PRIMARY', sticky footer shows dynamic 'Save N picks' (screenshot verified with N=2), Profile row subtitle correctly shows 'Primary: Jamin Brown · +1 more' format for multi-pick state. Recurring warning: 'Unexpected text node' still fires on every mount — third iteration in a row (see iteration_23, _24).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error whenever the caller picks ≥2 instructors with follow=true. Root cause: /app/backend/routes/instructors.py:_upsert_follows() writes {follower_id, following_id, created_at} but the follows collection has a unique index on (follower_id, followee_id) (see services/startup.py:69 and services/social.py). New docs get followee_id=null by omission, so the first insert succeeds with (follower_id, null) and the second insert for the same follower fails with pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError: E11000 duplicate key. Additionally, even single-target inserts are invisible to the rest of the app because following_ids() queries 'followee_id', not 'following_id' — auto-follow does not actually make the user 'follow' anyone from the app's POV. Fix: rename the field to 'followee_id' in both the filter and $setOnInsert, OR (preferred) delegate to services.social.follow() which already handles idempotency, updated_at, counters, and notifications.

rca_of_issue: PUT /api/auth/me/instructors with follow=true returns 500 for ≥2 picks. RCA: field name mismatch between new code and existing schema. Reproduction: (1) register a fresh user, (2) obtain user_ids for Erin + Jamin from GET /api/instructors, (3) PUT /api/auth/me/instructors {instructor_ids:[erin_id, jamin_id], main_instructor_id: jamin_id, follow: true} → 500. Backend log: pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError: E11000 duplicate key error collection: test_database.follows index: follower_id_1_followee_id_1 dup key: { follower_id: 'user_...', followee_id: null }. Mitigation: change field name in _upsert_follows from 'following_id' to 'followee_id' (2-line diff) OR delegate to existing services.social.follow() function which already handles idempotency + counters + notifications.
